card.title: How To Fix an iPad Air 4 boot looping after water damage using Panic Logs

source.title: How To Fix an iPad Air 4 boot looping after water damage using Panic Logs

claims.statement: A water-damaged iPad Air 4 that loops restarts but boots normally with the ambient light sensor flex unplugged has a shorted or faulty ALS flex.
Running with the ALS disconnected works as a temporary workaround but disables auto-brightness and True Tone.

procedure: Inspect and clean the ALS flex and connector with IPA.
Boot with ALS connected then disconnected to confirm.
Disconnect battery; replace the ALS flex with OEM/high-quality part.
Test boot, auto-brightness and True Tone.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
